questions.q: Compute the Manhattan (\( L_1 \)) norm and Euclidean (\( L_2 \)) norm of the word vector \( \mathbf{w} = [10, -15]^T \).
questions.answer: \( L_1 \) norm is the sum of absolute values: \( |10| + |-15| = 25 \). \( L_2 \) norm is the square root of sum of squares: \( \sqrt{(10)^2 + (-15)^2} = \sqrt{100 + 225} = \sqrt{325} \).

questions.q: Two document embeddings \( \mathbf{a} = [1, 2]^T \) and \( \mathbf{b} = [2, 1]^T \) are compared. If \( \|\mathbf{a}\| = \|\mathbf{b}\| = \sqrt{5} \), calculate their exact cosine similarity.
questions.answer: Dot product \( \mathbf{a} \cdot \mathbf{b} = (1)(2) + (2)(1) = 4 \). Product of norms \( \|\mathbf{a}\| \|\mathbf{b}\| = 5 \). Cosine similarity = \( \frac{4}{5} = 0.800 \).

questions.q: The coordinate diagram shows the parabolic curve \( f_1(x) = x^2 - 6x + 20 \) in the domain of Vectors & Embeddings in AI. By completing the square \( f_1(x) = (x - h)^2 + k \), find the sum \( k + f_1(5) \).
questions.answer:
**Mark Scheme & Examiner Solution (Vectors & Embeddings in AI):**
1. Complete the square: \( x^2 - 6x + 20 = (x - 3)^2 - 9 + 20 = (x - 3)^2 + 11 \), giving minimum value \( k = 11 \). **[M1]**
2. Evaluate at \( x = 5 \): \( f_1(5) = (2)^2 + 11 = 15 \). **[M1]**
3. Sum the two quantities: \( k + f_1(5) = 11 + 15 = 26 \). **[A1]**
- **Final Verified Answer:** \( 26 \).
